---
title: "Pre-bundle the Azure SDK's events dependency through the Azure adapter"
description: "Drop when the pinned release's withPayload pre-bundles the Azure SDK's events dependency only for sites with the Azure adapter, through an entry that resolves under pnpm."
---

<!-- Generated by `pnpm upstream export` from the patch's commit message on top of Payload v4.0.0-beta.3. Edit the commit, not this page. -->

vite dev warns "Cannot optimize dependency: @azure/storage-blob > events,
present in client 'optimizeDeps.include'" in every site without the Azure
storage adapter. withPayload lists that entry in its default
optimizeDeps.include, because it excludes @azure/storage-blob from the
client optimizer. Vite resolves each package of a nested entry from the
one before it, starting at the project root, so the entry also fails in a
pnpm site that installs @payloadcms/storage-azure: pnpm installs the SDK
inside the adapter, not at the root, and events is never pre-bundled.

The entry is now @payloadcms/storage-azure > @azure/storage-blob > events,
which resolves wherever the adapter is installed, Payload's own test
project included, and withPayload adds it only when the adapter resolves
from the project root.

- **Patch:** `tanstack-optional-azure-optimize-deps`, committed as `fix(tanstack-start): pre-bundle the Azure SDK's events dependency through the Azure adapter`
- **Upstream:** Not proposed
- **Tests:** `start vite dev in e2e after pnpm release e2e, load /admin, and check that the log has no "Cannot optimize dependency" line`
- **Diff:** [`upstream/patches/0019-fix-tanstack-start-pre-bundle-the-Azure-SDK-s-events.patch`](https://github.com/AdiRishi/offload-cms/blob/main/upstream/patches/0019-fix-tanstack-start-pre-bundle-the-Azure-SDK-s-events.patch)
